title: Use route-owned dashboard pages
summary: Split the dashboard into route-owned overview, topic index, topic document, facts, evidence, receipts, health, and graph pages under the existing TanStack Router/Start app.

title: Route params/search own content navigation
summary: Use route params and search/hash state for selected topic, major page, document kind, and selected shareable content state; remove section scroll state from primary navigation.

title: Use themed Markdown reference popover links
summary: Replace native title descriptions for Cartographer references with a themed hover/focus popover component in the Markdown anchor override path.

title: Use official Mermaid renderer for all current diagram families
summary: Render mermaid code fences through the official Mermaid renderer/registry with explicit feature-compatible security handling and registry-based validation coverage.

title: Validate routes, popovers, Mermaid corpus, safety, and build
summary: Layer browser, component, safety, Mermaid corpus, type, lint, and build checks around the navigation and Markdown changes.

title: Route tree and navigation descriptors
summary: TanStack route files and shared descriptors for overview, topics, and topic section pages.

title: Persistent route-aware dashboard shell
summary: Layout shell that renders shared chrome and navigation from route matches instead of managing activeSection scroll state.

title: Markdown ReferencePopoverLink
summary: Reference-specific anchor component that preserves safe link behavior and data attributes while showing themed hover/focus details.

title: MermaidDiagram renderer
summary: Lazy/client-safe Mermaid diagram component for mermaid code fences, responsive SVG output, and clear per-diagram errors.

title: Mermaid and navigation test corpus
summary: Representative route/history/popover/Mermaid corpus tests tied to current requirements and official diagram registry expectations.

title: Keep one giant page with improved scroll offsets
summary: Rejected because it leaves history, refresh, and direct links disconnected from the reviewed content.

title: Render only common Mermaid diagrams
summary: Rejected because the user requires all current Mermaid diagram types and features.

title: Execute arbitrary Mermaid callbacks in dashboard context
summary: Rejected because feature-compatible Mermaid rendering must not allow diagram text to mutate or escape the read-only dashboard safety boundary.

title: Route churn and duplicated loaders
summary: Splitting pages can create duplicated route loading logic; shared descriptors and existing collection hooks mitigate this.

title: Mermaid security and feature tension
summary: Permissive Mermaid settings may improve feature support but require isolation or safe-link policy to preserve dashboard safety.
